examples/calculations/coincidence.C

1// Run: bin/coinalgebra -l -b -q examples/calculations/coincidence.C
2#include "COINAlgebra/Core/DecayQuiver.h"
3#include "COINAlgebra/Detection/DetectionMaps.h"
4#include <iomanip>
5#include <iostream>
6
7void coincidence() {
8    DecayQuiver q;
9    auto* a=q.AddLevel("A",600); auto* b=q.AddLevel("B",400);
10    auto* c=q.AddLevel("C",100); auto* g=q.AddLevel("G",0);
11    auto* ab=q.AddTransition("AB",a,b);
12    auto* bc=q.AddTransition("BC",b,c);
13    auto* bg=q.AddTransition("BG",b,g);
14    auto* cg=q.AddTransition("CG",c,g);
15    std::vector<DecayLevel*> order{a,b,c,g};
16    DecayVector tau;
17    tau.AddTerm(DecayPath(*ab),1); tau.AddTerm(DecayPath(*bc),.75);
18    tau.AddTerm(DecayPath(*bg),.25); tau.AddTerm(DecayPath(*cg),1);
19    DecayVector branch(DecayPath(a),1), terminal(DecayPath(g),1);
20    // Deliberately synthetic calibration; replace these with measured values.
21    DetectionMaps maps({{"AB",.4},{"BC",.3},{"BG",.35},{"CG",.5}},
22                       {{"AB",.6},{"BC",.5},{"BG",.55},{"CG",.7}},4,
23                       {{"AB",0},{"BC",1},{"BG",0},{"CG",.25}});
24    CAlgebra physical(q,order,branch+tau);
25    const auto pairs=physical.Multiply(physical.Embed(branch),physical.Power(physical.Embed(tau),2));
26    CAlgebra out(q,order,maps.SummingOut(tau));
27    const auto spectrum=out.Multiply(out.Multiply(out.Embed(branch),
28        maps.SummingInExpansion(out,tau)),out.Embed(terminal));
29    std::cout << std::setprecision(12);
30    auto print=[](const char* title,const CAlgebra::Vector& vector) {
31        std::cout << "\n" << title << "\n";
32        for (const auto& term : vector)
33            std::cout << term.coefficient << "  " << term.coin.ToString() << "\n";
34    };
35    print("Physical transition pairs per decay (Eq. 61)",pairs);
36    print("Independent full-energy pair probabilities, without summing corrections",
37          maps.FullEnergyHit(pairs));
38    CAlgebra twoOut(q,order,maps.AvoidDetectors(tau,2));
39    auto resolved=twoOut.Multiply(twoOut.Multiply(twoOut.Embed(branch),
40        twoOut.Power(twoOut.Embed(maps.FullEnergyHit(tau)),2)),twoOut.Embed(terminal));
41    for (auto& term : resolved) term.coefficient*=3.0/4.0;
42    print("Two distinct clean detector peaks per decay, no summed-in groups",resolved);
43    print("Expected peaks per decay including disconnected sums (Eq. 70)",spectrum);
44    std::cout << "\nFor AB and CG: physical=.75; independent detection=.12;"
45                 " resolved distinct-detector pair=.07875; same-detector sum with BC avoiding that detector=.028125.\n";
46}
